fact: Statistics South Africa published the 2022 edition of Mortality and causes of death in South Africa: Findings from death notification (P0309.3) on 28 August 2025, a regular series based solely on administrative records from Department of Home Affairs death notification forms (BI-1663, DHA-1663), covering 486 041 deaths in 2022; the 2023 edition followed on 25 March 2026.
title: Mortality and causes of death in South Africa: Findings from death notification, 2022
